purpose: An UNSEALED, directional NOMINATION step: compare KD candidate recipes against a matched KD-disabled control and the calibrated anchor, to nominate at most one recipe to carry into a future full-Arm-2 training request. It confirms nothing for promotion and touches no sealed data.

KD_CONTROL.role: matched control at identical budget/seed/data-order so preservation is attributable to KD versus base under-training (Codex r31 f2)

shared_wrapper_requirement: BOTH modes MUST run pipeline.omniasr_calibrate so both emit identical serving-readyz / upstream-parity / dev-WER / authoritative receipts (post-approval implementation: remove the KD-enable entrypoint fork + the two KD-off short-circuits).

comparators_not_nominable.kind: frozen base checkpoint (inference only on the confirmation rows)
existing Arm-1 checkpoint (inference only on the confirmation rows)

comparators_not_nominable.note: calibrated anchor; COMPARATOR-ONLY (Codex r31): H0 can never be the nominated winner; candidates must BEAT it

no_selection_stage: The 600-step diagnostic screen is REMOVED (Codex r31: 'remove or fully predeclare its numerical rule'). There is NO intermediate selection. All six training arms (KD_CONTROL, H0, H1-H4) are trained FRESH to 2000 steps under one matched seed + data order, then scored once on the frozen confirmation split. No config is dropped on a partial-step heuristic.

training.matched: identical MEDZEN_SEED AND identical data ordering across all six arms
training.second_seed: the nominated finalist AND the KD_CONTROL are EACH re-run under a second matched seed; base_teacher and arm1 are existing checkpoints (no training)

evaluation.identical_rows_requirement: for every language, base_teacher, arm1, H0, KD_CONTROL and every candidate/finalist are scored on the SAME frozen confirmation rows, paired row-for-row (Codex r31: identical confirmation rows across all scored models)
evaluation.gating_tier_dictated_by_data: see the exposure inventory: only english/french/swahili/pidgin have an untouched candidate-blind split, so only those can be CONFIRMATION-GATED now (Phase A). lingala/kinyarwanda/ewe have NO untouched data and are DIRECTIONAL-only (reported, non-gating) pending Phase-B data acquisition.

phase_A_nomination_now.outcome: nominates at most one candidate recipe (directional); confirms nothing for promotion

phase_B_blind_gate_HELD.requirement: a truly base-blind, never-scored, untouched confirmation set for lingala/kinyarwanda/ewe (and base-blind english/french/swahili) does NOT exist in-repo and requires NEW licensed/commissioned data acquisition; the atomic 7-language blind promotion gate is BLOCKED on that acquisition and remains HELD. Part-2 alone can never promote.

base_preservation_non_inferiority.reference: the frozen base teacher's per-language WER on the SAME confirmation rows
base_preservation_non_inferiority.test: speaker cluster-bootstrap; PASS iff one-sided 95% upper bound of (WER_candidate - WER_base) <= +0.005 (0.5 absolute WER points) per gated language, after multiplicity correction

arm1_retention.reference: Arm-1's per-language WER on the SAME confirmation rows (arm1 checkpoint scored on the frozen split; not a stale number)
arm1_retention.test: speaker cluster-bootstrap; PASS iff one-sided 95% upper bound of (WER_candidate - WER_arm1) <= +0.005 (0.5pp) for pidgin, after multiplicity correction

constraints.kd_attribution: each candidate is compared DIRECTLY to the matched KD_CONTROL at identical budget/seed/data-order; a candidate must beat the control on the macro objective to credit any gain to KD, not training

statistics.metric: WER = sum(edit_distance) / sum(reference_words) per language, from per-row edit-distance receipts
statistics.clustering: SPEAKER-level cluster bootstrap (utterances from one speaker are correlated): resample SPEAKERS with replacement, B >= 10000, paired (the same resampled speaker set applied to both arms in each comparison). Pools with placeholder/single speaker ids (ewe soreva) fall back to utterance-level and are DIRECTIONAL-only regardless
statistics.seed_aggregation: the finalist + KD_CONTROL run under two matched seeds; a gated verdict PASSES only if it holds on the seed-POOLED cluster bootstrap AND under EACH seed individually (no seed reversal)
statistics.multiplicity_correction: Holm-Bonferroni across the FULL family = {4 candidates x 4 Phase-A gated languages x applicable constraint} + the beat-KD_CONTROL and beat-H0 macro tests, family-wise alpha = 0.05

macro_objective: unweighted mean WER across the four Phase-A confirmation-gated languages {english, french, swahili, pidgin}, on the seed-pooled confirmation split (lingala/kinyarwanda/ewe are directional and excluded from the gating macro)

selection_rule.qualify: a CANDIDATE (H1-H4) QUALIFIES iff, on the Phase-A confirmation split, after Holm-Bonferroni AND under both seeds: (a) base-preservation non-inferiority passes for english, french, swahili; AND (b) Arm-1 retention passes for pidgin; AND (c) it beats the matched KD_CONTROL on the macro objective (one-sided 95% lower bound of (WER_control - WER_candidate) > 0); AND (d) it beats the H0 anchor comparator on the macro objective (one-sided 95% lower bound of (WER_H0 - WER_candidate) > 0)
selection_rule.tie_break: among qualifiers, DETERMINISTIC: (1) lowest macro WER on the seed-pooled confirmation split; (2) ties -> lowest KD alpha; (3) ties -> lexicographically smallest recipe id
selection_rule.NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES: if NO candidate qualifies, the terminal outcome is NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES -> no Arm-2 recipe change is nominated (hold at H0), and a new design is predeclared; the protocol NEVER silently nominates the least-bad recipe
selection_rule.H0_is_comparator_only: H0 can never be the nominated winner; if no candidate beats H0 the outcome is NO_RECIPE_QUALIFIES

confirmation_data_rules.status: NOT YET MINTED — minting is post-approval; see exposure inventory B5-UNIVERSAL-ARM2-EXPOSURE-INVENTORY-2026-001
confirmation_data_rules.phaseA_split_source: the per-language dev-half REMAINDER for english/french/swahili/pidgin (pool minus the 60 selection rows minus the sealed half); pidgin (av-heldout remainder) is the only base+candidate-blind anchor
rules: DISJOINT by audio_checksum_sha256 from EVERY used_surface in the exposure inventory (training, the 420 dev-selection rows, the 386-row lingala sentinel, the 60-row sentinels, and all base-eval pools) AND from every sealed half
PREDECLARED + committed + FROZEN (per-row audio_checksum_sha256 + per-pool S3 version_id/etag/KMS) BEFORE any arm is scored
opened ONCE: all arms + comparators scored in a single pass per seed; no iterative re-fitting
the sealed promotion holdout is NEVER touched

cost_runtime_table.instance: ml.g6.xlarge on-demand (never spot); padded rate $1.60/h; fixed overhead ~1073 s/job; ~5.18 s/step

2 confirmation-scoring inference passes (all arms seed1; finalist+control seed2)

cost_runtime_table.note: base_teacher and arm1 are existing checkpoints scored within the confirmation-scoring passes (no training job).

budget.automatic_retries: NONE — any retry requires separate owner authorization
budget.reporting_rule: on-demand always; +$100 on every reported max => reported max <= $160
